summary: AI-powered web scraping has shifted from brittle, selector-based scripts toward LLM-driven extraction that can interpret page structure, respond to natural language queries, and self-heal when sites change. The 2026 landscape blends developer-first APIs (Firecrawl, Browserbase), autonomous AI scrapers (Kadoa, Browse AI), browser automation frameworks augmented with AI (Playwright, Puppeteer), and established data platforms (Apify, Diffbot). Adoption clusters at the top around tools that combine clean, LLM-ready output with reliable browser control for dynamic pages.

tools.name: Playwright
tools.pricing_paid: Free and open source; costs only for third-party hosting/cloud runners
ai_features: Integrates with LLM frameworks for AI-driven extraction and navigation
Playwright MCP server enables AI agents to drive browsers
Supports AI-assisted codegen and test/scrape generation
strengths: Handles dynamic pages, clicks, form fills, full browser interaction
Massive GitHub star count and community adoption
tools.best_for: Dynamic pages that need clicks, form fills, or full browser interaction

tools.name: Puppeteer
tools.pricing_paid: Free and open source; hosting costs only
ai_features: Commonly paired with LLMs to parse rendered DOM into structured data
Works with AI agent frameworks for autonomous browsing
strengths: Great for headless scraping and PDF/screenshot generation
tools.best_for: Headless Chrome automation and JavaScript-heavy page scraping

tools.name: Firecrawl
tools.pricing_paid: Paid plans start around $16/mo (Hobby) scaling to Standard/Growth tiers ($83+/mo)
ai_features: LLM-ready markdown and structured JSON output
Natural-language 'extract' endpoint for schema-based extraction
AI-powered crawling and content cleaning for RAG pipelines
strengths: Handles crawling, scraping, and conversion in one call
Strong fit for AI agents and RAG
tools.best_for: Developer-first API tool for turning websites into LLM-ready data

tools.name: Apify
tools.pricing_paid: Free $5 monthly credit; paid plans from ~$49/mo (Starter) with usage-based pricing
ai_features: AI-assisted Actors and integrations with LLMs
LLM-ready dataset outputs
Prebuilt AI scraping Actors in marketplace
strengths: Large Actor marketplace for ready-made scrapers
tools.best_for: Scraper marketplace and running scalable scraping/automation workflows at scale

tools.name: Browserbase
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier with limited browser hours; paid from ~$39/mo and usage-based scaling
ai_features: Headless browser infrastructure for AI agents
Stagehand framework for natural-language browser control
Integrates with LLM agent frameworks
strengths: Low-latency sessions with stealth and captcha handling
tools.best_for: Running headless browsers at scale for AI agents and automation

tools.name: Selenium
tools.pricing_paid: Free and open source; grid hosting costs only
ai_features: Pairs with LLMs for element location and data extraction
AI self-healing locators via third-party plugins
tools.best_for: Cross-language browser automation and legacy/enterprise test & scraping setups

tools.name: Browse AI
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier available; paid plans from ~$48.75/mo scaling with credits
ai_features: No-code AI visual training of scrapers (robots)
Automatic change detection and monitoring
AI-assisted data extraction without code
tools.best_for: No-code visual scraping and website change monitoring

tools.name: Kadoa
tools.pricing_paid: Free trial tier; paid plans custom/usage-based (enterprise-oriented)
ai_features: Fully autonomous AI scraping that adapts to layout changes
Natural-language data extraction specifications
Self-healing pipelines without manual selectors
strengths: Structured output ready for downstream use
tools.best_for: Fully autonomous AI scraping with minimal maintenance

tools.name: AgentQL
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier with monthly query allowance; paid from ~$99/mo
ai_features: Natural-language query language for locating web elements
AI-resilient selectors that survive layout changes
LLM-friendly structured data extraction
strengths: Semantic querying instead of brittle CSS/XPath
Works across sites without custom selectors
Good for AI agents interacting with pages
tools.best_for: Natural-language querying and locating elements for AI-driven automation

tools.name: Diffbot
ai_features: AI/ML-based automatic extraction APIs (Article, Product, etc.)
Knowledge Graph built from crawled web data
Computer-vision + NLP page understanding
strengths: Massive Knowledge Graph for entity data
tools.best_for: Automated structured extraction and large-scale web knowledge graphs

tools.name: Octoparse
tools.pricing_paid: Free plan available; paid from ~$99/mo (Standard) and higher tiers
ai_features: AI-assisted auto-detection of data fields
Natural-language/template-based extraction assistant
Automatic pagination and list detection
tools.best_for: No-code desktop/cloud scraping for non-technical users

tools.name: ScrapeGraphAI
tools.pricing_paid: Open source free; managed API with free credits, paid usage-based plans
ai_features: LLM-powered scraping pipelines defined by prompts
Graph-based extraction logic driven by natural language
Supports multiple LLM providers for extraction
strengths: Open source with strong GitHub traction
tools.best_for: Python developers building LLM-driven scraping pipelines from prompts
